bio.text: Jerry McNerney was elected to the California State Senate in November 2024, after serving in the U.S. Congress. His 5th District includes Alameda County's Tri-Valley area and all of San Joaquin County.
A native of Albuquerque, New Mexico, he earned bachelor's and master's degrees and a Ph.D. in mathematics at the University of New Mexico.
Before Congress he spent more than 20 years as an engineer and consultant in the energy and clean energy industry. He lives in Pleasanton.
